events.title: Agents that Pay
events.description:
Hosted by Exa, Coinbase, Visa, and Nevermined
Agents can search. Agents can plan. Now agents can pay.
The payment stack for the agentic web is being built in public, and it is already live. Visa is bringing agent transactions onto the world's largest card network. Coinbase's x402 turned HTTP into a checkout counter. And Nevermined and Exa just closed the loop: an agent can now buy Exa API calls autonomously with no human in the middle, no API key handoff, and just cardholder defined guardrails and a transaction itself.
It's the first real glimpse of what agentic commerce looks like in production.
Come hear from the teams building it. Then watch agents spend real money on stage
Featuring:
Jeff Wang is the Co-Founder of Exa, the search engine for AI agents. Exa enables LLMs and autonomous ag

score.reasoning: Event showcases production agentic systems (agents executing real transactions), which aligns with our shipping requirement, but the focus is narrowly on payment infrastructure rather than delivery methodology or stakeholder leadership. Hosts (Exa, Coinbase, Visa, Nevermined) skew fintech/infra, not traditional consulting or founded-startup talent pools.
